name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: A classic margherita pizza with a charred crust, topped with melted mozzarella cheese, red tomato sauce, and fresh green basil leaves, served on a wooden board with a side of sauce and olive oil.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Chicken tikka masala in a copper bowl with brass handles, garnished with cilantro and cream, served with basmati rice and naan bread on a dark wooden table.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: A vibrant vegetable stir-fry with golden-brown tofu, featuring broccoli, carrots, and snap peas, served in a white bowl with a savory brown sauce and accompanied by a side of white rice and chopsticks.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: A large white bowl filled with a Greek salad, featuring romaine lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, Kalamata olives, thinly sliced red onions, and crumbled feta cheese, with a silver serving spoon resting on the side, accompanied by a small glass bowl of dressing and a lemon wedge on a wooden table.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: A steaming bowl of spaghetti aglio e olio, topped with grated Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley, sits on a wooden table, accompanied by a fork and surrounded by small bowls of red pepper flakes and other ingredients.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: Glazed salmon fillet on a wooden board, garnished with fresh dill and spices, served with lemon wedges and a side of glaze sauce.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: Tomato basil soup in a light blue bowl, garnished with fresh basil leaves and herbs, surrounded by ingredients like tomatoes, garlic, and chili peppers.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: A plate of Pad Thai featuring stir-fried rice noodles, succulent shrimp, scrambled eggs, and mixed vegetables, garnished with sliced green onions and a lime wedge, served on a rustic wooden table surrounded by various seasonings and ingredients.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: Crispy chickpea falafel patties on a plate, garnished with parsley, served with sliced red onion, lemon, and garlic, accompanied by a side of creamy tahini sauce.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: Four tacos filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, salsa verde, and sour cream are arranged on a blue-gray plate, surrounded by scattered toppings and accompanied by bowls of additional salsa, cheese, and sour cream.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: A pan-seared ribeye steak is served in a skillet, sliced into thick strips and garnished with thyme sprigs and peppercorns, accompanied by three cubes of melting butter.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: A bowl of lentil dal garnished with cilantro, sliced tomatoes, onions, and a lime wedge, served in a ceramic bowl on a beige cloth napkin, with a spoon to the side and surrounded by fresh herbs and spices.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: Glazed cod fillet served on a bed of white sesame rice, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, and drizzled with a savory brown sauce.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: Caribbean Jerk Chicken is presented on a wooden platter, featuring four glazed chicken pieces garnished with rosemary and spices, surrounded by lime wedges and accompanied by bowls of rice, beans, salt, and a side sauce.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: Penne pasta is topped with roasted cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and shaved parmesan cheese, served on a rustic ceramic plate with a brown rim, surrounded by ingredients like garlic, salt, and additional tomatoes.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Paneer Butter Masala in a blue-rimmed bowl, featuring golden paneer cubes in a rich red sauce with onions and herbs, served with naan bread and basmati rice.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: Three glasses of Falooda, a dessert drink, are garnished with whipped cream, cherries, and rose petals, and layered with red jelly, vermicelli noodles, and milk.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: Shakshuka in a black skillet, featuring eggs poached in a rich, red sauce with sliced red and green peppers and onions, garnished with parsley, and served with a wooden spoon, surrounded by various ingredients and spices.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: A plate of Cuban Black Beans and Rice, featuring a mound of white rice topped with dark brown beans, sliced garlic, and garnished with two green leaves, presented on a white plate against a light beige background.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: Sliced beef bulgogi served on a dark plate with onions and green onions, garnished with sesame seeds, and accompanied by a bowl of white rice and various seasonings.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: Saffron-infused Spanish Paella Valenciana served in a large shallow pan, topped with roasted chicken, cherry tomatoes, onions, red peppers, and rosemary, surrounded by ingredients like whole onions, garlic, and spices.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: Steaming Tom Yum Goong soup in a white bowl, filled with shrimp, mushrooms, lemongrass, and red chili slices, garnished with fresh cilantro and a lime wedge.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: Grilled chicken breast strips are arranged on top of a fresh salad, consisting of romaine lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, and croutons, all tossed in a creamy dressing and sprinkled with shaved parmesan cheese.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: Moussaka in a baking dish, featuring layered eggplant slices topped with a rich meat sauce and melted cheese, surrounded by ingredients like tomatoes, spices, and seasonings on a rustic wooden table.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: A bowl of Shoyu Ramen with a rich brown broth, topped with sliced chicken, green onions, black and white sesame seeds, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg, served with yellow noodles.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: A plate of lemon garlic shrimp pasta, featuring cooked shrimp, sliced lemons, and green vegetables tossed with fettuccine noodles, presented on a beige ceramic plate and surrounded by ingredients like lemons, garlic cloves, salt, and pepper.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: A vibrant ratatouille dish is presented in a white bowl, filled with sliced zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, and red peppers, garnished with fresh herbs, and served on a wooden board surrounded by whole vegetables and spices.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: Pan-seared salmon fillets with crispy skin, seasoned with black pepper and garnished with dill, served on a ceramic plate with a side of dill-infused yogurt sauce and lemon wedges.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: Thai green curry with vegetables and tofu served with white rice in a bowl, garnished with basil leaves and surrounded by various ingredients and utensils on a gray surface.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: Mango sticky rice served in a blue-rimmed bowl with white rice topped with mango sauce, diced mango, and green leaves, accompanied by a plate of sliced mango and small bowls of sauce and salt.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: A bowl of herbed quinoa salad with sliced cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, and parsley, served on a gray surface with lemon wedges, olive oil, and scattered peppercorns.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: Beef shawarma wrap filled with sliced beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and lettuce, served with various dips and spices.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: Pesto Chicken Bake in a white baking dish, featuring four seared chicken breasts on a bed of pasta, melted cheese, and vibrant pesto sauce, garnished with roasted cherry tomatoes and accompanied by a side of pesto in a wooden spoon.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: Baked eggplant parmesan in a rectangular baking dish, layered with crispy breaded eggplant slices, red sauce, and melted cheese, surrounded by ingredients like tomatoes, onions, and grated cheese.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: A vibrant Moroccan Chickpea Stew is served in a decorative ceramic bowl, filled with chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and fresh cilantro, all in a rich reddish-brown broth, accompanied by a spoon and surrounded by ingredients like whole tomatoes and spices.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: A bowl of crunchy cabbage slaw, featuring shredded green cabbage and carrots, is centered on a table surrounded by various ingredients and condiments, including mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, and seasonings, with a knife and spoon nearby.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: Ceviche de Pescado in a shallow ceramic bowl, featuring raw white fish marinated with sliced red onions, halved red chili peppers, and cilantro, garnished with a lime wedge.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: Thai Basil Chicken served with steamed white rice on a decorative plate, garnished with fresh basil leaves and red chilies, surrounded by scattered ingredients and seasonings.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: A Caprese salad is arranged on a white plate, featuring alternating slices of red tomatoes and white mozzarella cheese, garnished with green basil leaves and drizzled with a dark brown glaze and light yellow oil, served on a wooden board with a small bowl of glaze and a fork alongside.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: Pumpkin risotto in a black pan, divided into sections with creamy risotto, diced pumpkin, thinly sliced red onion, and melting butter, accompanied by various ingredients and cooking elements around the pan.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: Succulent shrimp swim in a savory garlic butter sauce in a black skillet, garnished with parsley and garlic slices, and served on a wooden tray with lemon wedges, melted butter, and fresh garlic bulbs.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: Roasted red pepper hummus in a dark bowl, garnished with red chili peppers, chickpeas, and olive oil, surrounded by pita bread, salt, garlic, and spices.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: Garlic naan bread arranged on a plate with a small bowl of garlic cloves in the center, topped with garlic and herbs, served with a fork and knife on the side.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Butter chicken in a blue bowl, featuring tender chicken cubes in a rich, red-orange sauce, garnished with green leaves, onions, and spices, presented against a dark blue background.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: Steaming hot Coconut Curry Lentil Soup in a clay bowl, garnished with red chilies, onions, and herbs, and topped with a swirl of cream, surrounded by ingredients like turmeric, lentils, and lemons.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: A gyro wrap filled with sliced lamb, red onion, tomato, cucumber, and tzatziki sauce, wrapped in a toasted pita bread and served on a wooden board with a side of tzatziki sauce.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: Roasted chicken cut into eight pieces, arranged on a clay platter and garnished with lime slices and spices, surrounded by additional limes, garlic cloves, and seasonings.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: Grilled chicken breasts topped with a vibrant mango salsa, featuring diced mango, red onion, and red pepper, served on a round ceramic plate with lime wedges and cilantro garnishes.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: Rice paper rolls filled with shrimp, carrots, and vegetables are arranged on a woven platter, accompanied by a bowl of creamy peanut dip garnished with sesame seeds and mint, surrounded by fresh lettuce, cucumber, noodles, and tofu.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: A platter of beef nachos topped with ground beef, beans, cheese, sour cream, sliced jalapenos, and cherry tomatoes, surrounded by bowls of salsa, shredded cheese, and other toppings on a wooden table.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: Grilled chicken skewers with herbs and spices, served on a gray plate with lemon wedges and drizzled with oil, surrounded by scattered salt, peppercorns, and rosemary sprigs.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: Coconut shrimp curry in a black pan, featuring pink shrimp, sliced red peppers, onions, green chilies, and herbs in a yellow sauce.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: A bowl of creamy risotto topped with sautéed mushrooms and fresh herbs, served in a brown ceramic bowl on a beige napkin, surrounded by ingredients like grated Parmesan cheese, olive oil, and whole mushrooms.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: Golden brown lemon ricotta pancakes topped with a lemon curd, powdered sugar, and butter, served on a metal platter with accompanying ingredients and toppings.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: Egg fried rice with peas, carrots, and tofu, topped with four sunny-side-up eggs and sprinkled with black sesame seeds and green onions, served in a dark pan with soy sauce on the side.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: Okonomiyaki, a Japanese pancake, is served on a round plate with shredded cabbage underneath, topped with shrimp, mayonnaise, and sauce, and sprinkled with a green seasoning. The dish is accompanied by small bowls of sauce and mayonnaise, and a sake jug on a wooden table.

name: Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon
directions: Cook pasta; reserve some pasta water.
Toss with lemon zest, juice, herbs, and olive oil.
Add a splash of pasta water; finish with parmesan.
image_description: Penne pasta tossed in a vibrant green herb sauce, topped with grated Parmesan cheese, fresh basil leaves, and lemon wedges, served in a rustic bowl on a wooden board.

name: Coconut Rice with Beans
directions: Simmer coconut milk with garlic powder; stir in beans and cilantro.
Serve over rice.
image_description: Coconut rice with beans in a large silver bowl, surrounded by ingredients including white rice, black beans, coconut milk, spices, garlic, oil, and fresh herbs, arranged on a gray surface.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato and Olive
directions: Place cod in baking dish; top with tomatoes, olives, and garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil; bake at 200°C (400°F) for 12-15 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
image_description: Baked cod fillet topped with a mixture of diced tomatoes and olives, surrounded by halved cherry tomatoes, green and black olives, and roasted garlic cloves, all in a savory olive oil sauce, garnished with parsley on a rustic plate.

name: Seared Tuna Niçoise
directions: Sear tuna to desired doneness.
Boil beans and potatoes; assemble with eggs and olives.
Dress with lemon vinaigrette.
image_description: Seared tuna steak served with boiled potatoes, green beans, olives, and halved hard-boiled eggs, garnished with lemon wedges and herbs, on a round plate with forks on either side.

name: Harissa Chickpea Bowl
directions: Roast chickpeas with harissa 15-20 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with fresh vegetables and lemon yogurt sauce.
image_description: A vibrant Harissa Chickpea Bowl is served in a decorative bowl, featuring couscous topped with harissa chickpeas, sliced cucumbers, diced tomatoes, and a dollop of white sauce, garnished with green onions and herbs.

name: Salmon with Dill and Mustard Glaze
directions: Mix glaze with mustard, dill, and honey.
Brush on salmon; bake or pan-sear until flaky.
image_description: Two grilled salmon fillets topped with a mustard and dill glaze, served on a dark baking sheet with scattered herbs and coarse salt.

name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Avocado
directions: Toss greens with avocado and tomatoes.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and serve.
image_description: A fresh butter lettuce salad with diced avocado and halved cherry tomatoes, served in a white bowl with a brown rim, and being drizzled with a yellow dressing from a small pitcher held by a hand.

name: Eggplant Caponata
directions: Sauté eggplant until soft.
Add vegetables and simmer with vinegar and sugar until thick.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
image_description: A colorful Eggplant Caponata dish is served in a shallow ceramic bowl, featuring sautéed eggplant, green olives, capers, celery, and tomatoes in a rich sauce, accompanied by a wooden spoon and garnished with fresh parsley and halved cherry tomatoes on the side.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
directions: Toast bread; mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Poach eggs; place on toast and serve.
image_description: Toasted bread topped with mashed avocado, sliced avocado, and two poached eggs, served on a light plate with lemon wedges and seasoned with salt, pepper, and herbs.

name: Herbed Tomato Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes; blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and herbs; season and serve.
image_description: A bowl of vibrant red tomato soup is garnished with sliced tomatoes, fresh basil, thyme, and a swirl of cream, served in a dark gray bowl on a matching surface surrounded by ingredients and cooking elements.

name: Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes
directions: Boil gnocchi until floating; drain.
Toss with pesto and halved tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: Pesto gnocchi tossed with halved cherry tomatoes and topped with shredded parmesan cheese, served on a white plate with a brown rim and garnished with basil leaves.

name: Paneer Butter Fry
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add paneer and brown.
Add tomato paste and spices; simmer with a splash of cream.
image_description: Paneer butter masala in a dark bowl, topped with a dollop of white cream and spices, featuring golden-brown paneer cubes, onions, and tomatoes in a rich red sauce.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Brussels Sprouts
directions: Toss sprouts with oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes; finish with lemon zest.
image_description: Roasted Brussels sprouts in a brown bowl, tossed with roasted garlic cloves and lemon slices, and seasoned with salt, pepper, and spices.

name: Paneer Tarsi with Spinach
directions: Sauté onion and tomato; add spices.
Stir in spinach until wilted; add paneer and simmer briefly.
image_description: A pan of Paneer Tarsi with Spinach, featuring cubes of paneer, spinach leaves, cherry tomatoes, and onion rings, surrounded by various ingredients and spices, including whole spices, powders, and fresh herbs, arranged in small bowls and scattered around the pan.

name: Rendang Beef
directions: Simmer beef with coconut milk and rendang paste with aromatics until tender and thickened.
image_description: Rendang Beef in a large brown ceramic bowl, garnished with green leaves and surrounded by various ingredients and spices in small bowls, including shallots, ginger, lemongrass, and star anise, on a wooden table.

name: Chili Con Carne
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add beef and brown.
Add spices, tomato sauce, and beans; simmer 25-30 minutes.
image_description: A bowl of Chili Con Carne, garnished with green onions and basil, sits on a wooden table surrounded by ingredients including kidney beans, spices, onions, garlic, and chili peppers.

name: Persian Jeweled Rice
directions: Cook rice; mix with saffron and jeweled mix of nuts and dried fruits.
Fluff and serve.
image_description: Persian Jeweled Rice is served in an ornate gold-rimmed dish, topped with dried fruits, nuts, and saffron-infused rice, arranged artfully on a beige cloth with scattered ingredients and a gold spoon nearby.

name: Moroccan Lentil Soup (Harira)
directions: Sauté onions, garlic; add tomato paste and spices.
Add lentils and chickpeas with water; simmer until tender.
Finish with lemon juice and herbs.
image_description: A vibrant Moroccan Lentil Soup, or Harira, is presented in a large black bowl, garnished with fresh parsley and featuring chickpeas, sliced tomatoes, and onions in a rich, reddish-brown broth. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, including a halved lemon, whole tomatoes, onions, and small bowls of spices, arranged on a brown surface.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
directions: Sauté curry paste in oil; add chicken to sear.
Pour in coconut milk; add vegetables and simmer until cooked.
Finish with basil and fish sauce.
image_description: Thai red curry with chicken, bell peppers, and cashews in a rich, vibrant sauce, garnished with fresh basil leaves and served in a ceramic bowl on a wooden table.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil; add tomato sauce.
Toss with pasta and garnish with parsley.
image_description: Penne pasta tossed in a spicy tomato sauce, topped with halved cherry tomatoes, parsley, and red chili peppers, served in a brown ceramic bowl on a wooden table with a fork and surrounded by scattered ingredients.

name: Cranberry Walnut Salad
directions: Toss greens with cranberries, walnuts, and cheese.
Drizzle with vinaigrette.
image_description: A fresh salad in a beige bowl features mixed greens, crumbled white cheese, sliced cucumber, red cranberries, and chopped walnuts, topped with a dark brown dressing and surrounded by scattered ingredients and condiments on a dark gray surface.

name: Corn Chowder
directions: Sauté onion in butter; add potatoes and corn.
Add milk and simmer until thickened; season.
image_description: A bowl of creamy corn chowder is surrounded by ingredients and seasonings, featuring diced corn and scallions in a pale yellow broth, with a spoon on the right side and a salt shaker on the left.

name: Eggplant Yakitori Skewers
ingredients: Soy glaze: soy sauce, sugar, mirin
directions: Skewer eggplant chunks; brush with glaze.
Grill until tender; garnish with sesame seeds.
image_description: Grilled eggplant slices on wooden skewers, glazed with a dark sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds, are arranged on a gray plate with a brown rim, accompanied by a small bowl of sauce and sesame seeds in the background.

name: Chana Masala
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 15-20 minutes.
image_description: Chana Masala in a large brown bowl, garnished with sliced tomatoes, onions, and herbs, surrounded by ingredients like chickpeas, spices, garlic, and raw tomatoes, presented on a gray surface.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients; whisk in wet ingredients until smooth.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: Golden-brown buttermilk pancakes are stacked in a skillet, topped with poached eggs and drizzled with syrup, set against a warm and inviting breakfast scene with ingredients and condiments on a wooden table.

name: Mango Lassi
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Chill and serve.
image_description: A glass of mango lassi sits on a rustic wooden table, surrounded by ingredients including a halved mango, cardamom pods, and bowls of sugar and spices, with a creamy white drink topped with a sprinkle of spice and a layer of mango puree.

name: Pesto Pasta with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
directions: Cook pasta; drain.
Toss with pesto and sun-dried tomatoes; top with parmesan.
image_description: Pesto pasta with sun-dried tomatoes served on a white plate, topped with grated Parmesan cheese and surrounded by ingredients like cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, and cheese blocks.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
directions: Form patties and brown in a pan; set aside.
Make gravy with mushrooms, onion, flour, and broth; return patties to pan and simmer.
image_description: A Salisbury steak patty is centered in a bowl, smothered in rich brown mushroom gravy and topped with sautéed mushrooms and chopped scallions. The dish is accompanied by a side of white rice and a swirl of onions, with a pat of butter on the side, all presented in a brown-rimmed bowl against a dark background.

name: Simple Garlic Herb Salmon
directions: Season salmon; sear in a pan with garlic and herbs.
Finish with lemon juice and serve.
image_description: Pan-seared salmon fillets topped with garlic, herbs, and spices, served in a skillet with lemon and fresh dill.

name: Gnocchi with Sage Butter
directions: Cook gnocchi until floating.
Brown butter with sage; toss with gnocchi and parmesan.
image_description: Pan-seared gnocchi topped with sage leaves and grated Parmesan cheese is served in a ceramic bowl, surrounded by small bowls of olive oil, grated cheese, and Parmesan blocks, with a fork and spoon on a napkin to the side.

name: Shredded Beef Tostadas
directions: Slow-cook beef with spices until tender; shred.
Top tostadas with beef and toppings.
image_description: Shredded beef tostadas on a black plate, topped with salsa, sour cream, and cilantro, surrounded by lime wedges and accompanied by bowls of salsa, sour cream, cheese, and spices on a rustic wooden table.

name: Chili Lime Grilled Corn
directions: Grill corn until charred; brush with butter.
Sprinkle chili powder and drizzle lime juice; season.
image_description: Grilled corn on the cob smothered in spices, minced garlic, chili slices, and lime wedges, served on a black slate plate with a side of loose corn kernels and spices.

name: Herbed Rice with Peas
directions: Cook rice with peas; stir in greens and butter.
image_description: A bowl of herbed rice with peas is centered, surrounded by ingredients and seasonings including raw peas, onions, herbs, oil, and spices, arranged on a light-colored surface.

name: Gulai Ayam (Indonesian Curry Chicken)
directions: Sauté curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer with vegetables until cooked.
image_description: Chicken curry served in a black pan with golden handles, featuring chunks of chicken, carrots, potatoes, green beans, and peas in a rich yellow sauce, garnished with green herbs.

name: Spicy Peanut Noodles
directions: Cook noodles; whisk sauce with peanut butter.
Toss noodles with sauce and sesame seeds.
image_description: A bowl of Spicy Peanut Noodles is surrounded by various ingredients, including peanuts, sliced red and green chilies, sesame seeds, and green onions. The noodles are topped with peanuts, sesame seeds, seaweed, and sliced chilies, and are served in a blue-rimmed bowl with a wooden spoon beside it.

name: Herbed Quiche
directions: Whisk eggs with cream and herbs.
Fill crust with cheese and vegetables; pour mixture and bake until set.
image_description: Herbed quiche cut into eight slices, featuring a golden-brown crust and a filling with eggs, spinach, and mushrooms, surrounded by ingredients like cheese, herbs, and spices.

name: Baked Ziti
directions: Cook pasta; mix with sauce and meat.
Top with cheese and bake until bubbly.
image_description: Baked ziti in a white ceramic dish topped with melted cheese and ground meat, surrounded by fresh tomatoes and a side of marinara sauce.

name: Herbed Shrimp and Grits
directions: Prepare grits as per package instructions with butter.
Sauté shrimp with garlic; stir in lemon and parsley.
Serve shrimp over grits.
image_description: A bowl of creamy grits topped with sautéed shrimp, garlic, and parsley, finished with a savory sauce and black pepper, served on a white plate with a spoon and accompanied by a side of green sauce and lemon wedge.

name: Duck Confit (Simple Version)
ingredients: Duck legs confit (or duck legs and fat)
directions: Crisp duck skin in a hot skillet; finish in oven until skin is golden and meat is tender.
image_description: Two golden-brown duck legs are served in a dark pan filled with rich fat, garlic cloves, and herbs, presented on a wooden board with seasonings and utensils.

name: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
directions: Mix ingredients; bake in loaf pan until a toothpick comes out clean.
image_description: A lemon olive oil cake in a loaf pan, partially sliced to reveal its moist yellow interior, is garnished with herbs and surrounded by lemons, lemon slices, olive oil, and eggs.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine
directions: Combine ingredients in a tajine or pot; simmer until chicken is cooked and flavors meld.
image_description: A hearty Salsa Verde Chicken Tajine is served in a traditional clay pot with handles, filled with tender chicken, potatoes, chickpeas, carrots, onions, and green and black olives, all simmered in a rich green sauce and garnished with fresh herbs.

name: Coconut Lime Chicken
directions: Sauté garlic and curry paste; add chicken and coconut milk.
Simmer until chicken is cooked; finish with lime juice.
image_description: Coconut lime chicken served in a gray bowl with a yellow curry sauce, topped with sliced limes, red chili peppers, garlic cloves, shallots, and cilantro, surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings on a dark blue surface.

name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cook filling with spinach and feta; stuff peppers.
Bake in sauce until peppers tender.
image_description: Stuffed green and yellow peppers filled with rice, spinach, and feta cheese, arranged in a cast iron skillet on a bed of marinara sauce and garnished with basil leaves.

name: Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad)
ingredients: Peanut sauce: peanuts, palm sugar, tamarind, lime
directions: Arrange vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a plate.
Drizzle with warm peanut sauce and serve.
image_description: A vibrant Indonesian Gado-Gado salad is arranged on a blue plate, featuring a mix of steamed vegetables, tofu, and boiled eggs, topped with a rich peanut sauce and garnished with peanuts and fresh herbs.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: Kung Pao Chicken is served in a wok, featuring crispy chicken, red chilies, and peanuts in a savory sauce, surrounded by ingredients like garlic, soy sauce, and peanuts.

name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: Mapo tofu in a large wok, topped with green onions, featuring cubes of tofu and minced meat in a savory brown sauce, served with a wooden spoon.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: Sliced beef and broccoli are stir-fried with mushrooms and served in a black wok, garnished with cashews and peas, and accompanied by various seasonings and sauces on the side.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: Crispy General Tso's chicken tossed in a savory brown sauce, served with steamed white rice and garnished with sliced red chilies and ginger, in a brown ceramic bowl.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: Pan-seared pork potstickers served in a cast iron skillet with a side of soy sauce and sesame seeds, garnished with green onions.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: Hot and Sour Soup served in a black pot with tofu, bamboo shoots, noodles, and green onions in a light brown broth, topped with a raw egg yolk.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: A plate of Chow Mein noodles mixed with colorful vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and bell peppers, served with chopsticks and accompanied by soy sauce and sesame seeds in small bowls.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: Three bowls of wonton soup sit on a wooden tray, each containing wontons and green onions in a clear broth, surrounded by various condiments and seasonings in small bowls.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: Succulent shrimp are piled high in a blue ceramic bowl, smothered in a rich, creamy sauce and topped with chopped walnuts. The dish is garnished with vibrant green broccoli florets and halved quail eggs, adding a pop of color and texture to the presentation.
